workouts.title: Upper Body Strength
workouts.description: Build a strong foundation with simple upper-body exercises. Focus on controlled movements and steady breathing.
workouts.tip: Keep your body in a straight line during push-ups. Rest 60–90 seconds between sets.

workouts.title: Leg Day Essentials
workouts.description: A lower-body session designed to develop strength, balance, and control using basic movements.
workouts.tip: Keep your knees aligned with your toes and use a comfortable range of motion.

workouts.title: Cardio Energy Boost
workouts.description: Raise your heart rate with a short cardio circuit. Adjust the pace to your fitness level and take breaks when needed.
exercises: March or jog in place — 3 minutes
workouts.tip: Warm up before starting and finish with easy walking to cool down.
